method: Whole evaluated source triangles enclosed by at least one matching functional-group convex hull; this proves continuous source-triangle coverage between vertices. Barycentric collider surface grids and actual closed-source winding/Euclidean triangle distance measure overreach. Dense continuous segment clipping is compared with exact source-triangle intersections, including expected blocked supports/shelves/floor/ends and a deliberately invalid enclosing-hull control. Source caches are independently evaluated Batch07 evidence, exact-hash bound to unchanged current .blend files and baseline commit.
limits: Finite collider-boundary error samples are measured bounds at samples, not a proof of a global Hausdorff maximum. A 10 mm radial chord parameter is not a bound on total preexisting profile-convexification error.
Offline geometry only; no native physics solver, runtime cost, controller, actor fit or continuous mechanical certification.
Decorative ribs/reveal/grip were already omitted in the original collision proposal; their absence is explicit and does not establish per-ornament physical contact.
